evidence.detail: HEAD exactly matched the launcher-supplied target SHA; the base commit resolved exactly; the detached worktree was clean.

evidence.detail: Reviewed the complete base-to-target diff. It adds API-backed and sample-backed UI rendering, policy cards, findings, score presentation, CSP, no-store response headers, tests, documentation, and workflow records.

The repair uses a monotonic generation counter, invalidates pending result loads before logout, clears rendered tenant data immediately, and checks the captured generation after asynchronous fetch and body-parsing boundaries.

Tenant and finding values are rendered through createElement/textContent. The reviewed application code contains no innerHTML, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, document.write, eval, or Function constructor sink.
The page includes a restrictive same-origin CSP with base, form, and object restrictions; sensitive successful policy and analysis responses receive Cache-Control: no-store.
The committed fixture contains hostile markup in a policy display name, and static safety tests cover forbidden sinks, fixture presence, and the generation-guard structure.
README documents live rendering, the offline sample button, heuristic scoring, and local verification commands.
git diff --check completed with exit 0, and web/sample-data.json parsed successfully with python3 -m json.tool.

The prescribed unit-test command ran 80 tests but exited 1: 19 server integration tests could not bind a loopback socket because the review sandbox returned PermissionError [Errno 1]. No assertion failure was observed before the environment errors.
The prescribed compile command exited 1 because the read-only checkout prohibited creation of __pycache__.
The governance validator exited 1 because no writable temporary directory was available in the review sandbox.

The handoff claims compile exit 0, 80 passing tests, validator success, and curl-based inspection, but explicitly records that browser execution was unavailable. Author claims are not independent review evidence.
DECISION-004 documents that this read-only, socket-restricted, temp-less launcher environment cannot run the prescribed checks and requires Codex to report that evidence limitation rather than PASS.

limitations: Required independent execution evidence is incomplete: unit tests, compilation, and governance validation could not complete because the review environment prohibits loopback socket binding, bytecode-cache writes, and temporary-directory creation.

Acceptance criteria 1, 4, and 6 require real browser rendering/no-console-error and hostile-markup behavior evidence. No browser was available, and the handoff expressly records that live in-browser hostile-fixture verification was not performed.
A live tenant run was not performed because it would require authentication/network access outside this review's available authority and environment.

Static review found no unresolved substantive correctness or security defect. Residual risk remains around browser/runtime behavior and live Graph integration until the required manual render checks are executed against this exact SHA.
review.summary: Static review of ISSUE-0005 repair round 2 found no unresolved substantive defect. The async result/sign-out race is guarded, sensitive content is cleared immediately, rendering uses inert text sinks, policy conditions are represented, CSP/no-store requirements are implemented, and documentation is updated. The review is BLOCKED solely because mandatory independent execution and browser evidence could not be obtained in the read-only, socket-restricted, temp-less review environment; DECISION-004 assigns disposition of this recurring evidence-only blocker to the human after considering the author's out-of-band evidence.
